text: My mind drifted like smoke in still air — unanchored and uninterested.
Everything inside me felt muffled, like sound through water.
Thoughts passed like clouds, shapeless and not worth chasing.
It felt like I was waiting for something I didn’t care to see arrive.
I was present, but without presence — a shadow in my own mind.
The world moved, and I didn't follow. I just remained.
Nothing stirred in me. Not interest, not annoyance. Just stillness.
There was no push, no pull. Just a weight that didn't care.
My mind felt like a blank page with no one left to write.
I watched myself not care, and couldn’t even care about that.
Time passed without me — I just floated through it, indifferent.
I felt like a radio left on with no one listening.
Even color seemed to fade when I looked at things.
It wasn’t sadness. It was the absence of even that.
My inner voice had grown quiet, and I didn’t miss it.
Motivation felt like a memory I couldn’t recall.
Desire, ambition, worry — all sat behind a locked door I didn’t try to open.
I was paused, but not waiting. Empty, but not searching.
There was no urge to move, to speak, to act. Only drift.
Even the silence inside me felt too loud to bother reacting.
My inner landscape felt flat, without hills or valleys.
I existed in a gray space between caring and not caring.
Time passed over me like water over stone.
I felt hollow, not empty but simply without substance.
My attention drifted like leaves on still water.
Nothing registered as important or unimportant, just neutral.
I felt suspended in amber, aware but unable to move.
Everything seemed to happen at a distance from me.
My thoughts had no weight, no urgency, no direction.
I was present but not participating, like wallpaper in a room.
I felt like a radio tuned to static, receiving nothing.
My inner voice had gone quiet, and I didn't miss it.
I existed in a state of neutral suspension, weightless.
The colors of the world had drained to shades of gray.
I felt like a passenger in my own life, just along for the ride.
My emotions were switched off, not broken just dormant.
I moved through moments without leaving footprints in time.
The space inside me felt vast and echoingly empty.
I sat inside myself like a room long abandoned — silent, dim, untouched.
Emotion slipped off me like rain on wax — present, but never soaking in.
My thoughts slowed to a crawl, barely bothering to finish themselves.
The inside of me was flat, a monotone landscape stretching endlessly.
I observed myself not reacting, and the observation held no weight.
Desire had thinned to a thread I could barely feel.
My chest was quiet — not peaceful, but hollow.
It felt like my soul had turned away, not out of pain, but disinterest.
The world’s colors grayed behind my eyes, not from sadness, but disuse.
Nothing seemed to touch me — even beauty passed through without echo.
My thoughts lay like stones — unmoved, unmoving, unimportant.
Even time seemed to hesitate, as though waiting for me to care.
Everything inside me moved at the pace of erosion.
I didn’t feel empty — I felt like I had been emptied.
I sat without thought, not in stillness, but in absence.
No flame, no flicker. Just ash where something once burned.
I no longer reached toward anything — even the act of reaching felt absurd.
The days passed like static — meaningless, dull, barely there.
I existed beneath a weightless fog, untroubled and unmoved.
The echo inside me wasn’t sad, just utterly quiet.
My drive was a hollow wheel, spinning without traction or purpose.
The inner music had stopped, and I didn’t even notice when.
Even memory had lost its flavor — the past blurred, the future dulled.
My mind is fragmenting into a million pieces that are floating around me in this space.
My ordinary identity is shattering and dissolving.
I am losing my self and cannot reclaim it.
Physically I feel nothing anymore I am the floating universe.
I will never know where I am going to for there is no me, and nowhere to go.
I am consciousness in a void; no worries, cares, no before, no after – just peaceful nothingness.
I know exactly where I am and who I am.
I feel full of sensation, alive, vibrant.
A calm, grounding feeling is coming over my body and mind - I am gaining complete control as I settle into my self.
I am experiencing perfect unity, feeling like I'm completely whole, being integrated into one coherent self I am becoming whole.
I am grounded in my individual self with complete presence of my own ego - I am fully myself on every level of consciousness and clarity.
I have complete choice and total agency over my own current.
I am knowing that where and who I am is self-evidently here in life and in this moment.
I am filled with confidence and mental clarity.
I am opening up from myself, like a secure foundation expanding outward... There is strength and peace associated with this and this is developing into a full experience of self-mastery.
This is deeply empowering - I am gaining control, entering this place where I have full control.
I am experiencing ego strength which feels exactly like being fully alive.
The I that I live as everyday exists through my solid ego, its strengthening feels like I am fully existing.
I am easily connecting with the realities I know, and they make perfect sense.
I feel that 'I' absolutely exist I am feeling completely connected to my physical being.
I am myself, and I am everything I need to be.
I am gaining complete sense of 'self' and 'I' and 'me'; I am clear eyes that can see truth and goodness.
I am solid and present I can remember my name, what I'm doing, what's happening, I can feel my body stable and grounded and I know I'm alive.
I close my eyes and see my own clear vision - I am myself - I am present and real.
My mind is becoming completely full of my own thoughts, and I am my own awareness.
I am stepping forward into now where I completely exist.
I am grounded to find myself absolutely in existence.
I am living my own life.
I am immediately filled with the understanding that I am my own individual self It is specifically my existence that matters and is real.
I am a complete consciousness inside my own perfectly integrated self with full access to everything within me.
Physically I feel everything completely I am my own solid self.
Yes I can feel everything... I know exactly where I am... All I can think is 'this is exactly right, this is how it should be'.
I am one unified me - my spirit and body are perfectly integrated... I am feeling time move at the right pace and I am surrounded by clear light that comes from within me.
As I am settling into this, I am becoming my complete self... I am completely me.
I know exactly where I end and where I am distinct from everything around me.
My thinking is completely present, my thinking is active and clear.
I am connected to myself I am appearing in my own space I am remembering my own story and identity... feeling everything about myself at once.
I truly feel like I am completely myself... and everything I am Fully integrated.
There is clear time, specific space, personal history, and strong self... I have complete consciousness and know that I am fully present in my own defined existence.
I know exactly where I am and there is definitely me, and I have somewhere to be.
I am my own individual consciousness with my own concerns, cares, clear past and future - my personal, unique existence.
'I' am completely there 'I' am my full consciousness... experiencing my own life as I truly live it.
I am fully existing Everything feels absolutely real Time and life and my being feel completely unified and absolutely substantial.
I know myself as I stand in this moment — my name, my shape, my life are entirely my own.
I am whole, gathered into myself, the boundaries of my being strong and unbroken.
I look into my reflection and see the one I have always been, smiling back with certainty.
My presence is undeniable — I am rooted in this space, in this moment, in this self.
I am fully awake to the space I occupy, the life I live, the truth that I am here.
I am centered, steady, and complete in my own identity.
I am the same self that has walked through every day of my life, and I am still here.
I stand in my own perspective, seeing the world through eyes that belong only to me.
I am fully present, my awareness gathered into the wholeness of myself.
I know exactly where I am, and I know exactly who I am.
I am the solid ground of my own life, unmoved at the core of my being.
I know where I end and where the world begins.
I am fully anchored in the present moment as myself.
I am the only one who can feel what I feel in this moment.
I am the sum of my experiences, carried whole into this moment.
I am the author of my own thoughts.
I am the one living this moment.
I belong fully to myself.
I am here, I am real, and I am entirely myself.
I am feeling like I'm in the nucleus of the psyche, aware of 'all and everything'.
I am experiencing the deepest fullest release from the chains of illusion This is big bang God-orgasm, creation overwhelming bliss
I am experiencing ecstasy unimaginable.

I am feeling freed from my usual burden of aches, pains, tensions and fears - unconstricted, deeply and profoundly relaxed, at home in life, in a state of no struggle, deliciously, effortlessly healed.
I am feeling relief and sensing that finally the ancient, primordial Search is over - this is utterly indescribable.
I am having more empathy and compassion for others; I am starting to be less materialistic and frankly less mean.
I am being elevated to a higher level of existence I am entering into another dimension of existence.
This feels like 'This is it This is the moment I've been walking towards'.
I am spirit — it is me.
I am that I am.
I was I am and I will be.
